description_en: Uploads a new version of an application plug-in
name: UploadAppPluginVersion

parameters.help_en: The new version number in semver format. The version must be greater than the current version
parameters.help_zh: 新版本号（semver，必须大于当前版本）
parameters.name: plugin_version

parameters.help_en: The OSS key obtained after frontend direct upload. This parameter is mutually exclusive with DownloadUrl
parameters.help_zh: 前端直传后的 OSS key（与 DownloadUrl 二选一）
parameters.name: oss_key

parameters.help_en: The downloadable ZIP URL. This parameter is mutually exclusive with OssKey
parameters.help_zh: 可下载的 ZIP 链接（与 OssKey 二选一）
parameters.name: download_url

parameters.help_en: The description. This parameter is optional. If a non-empty value is specified, the description field in the main table is also updated
parameters.help_zh: 描述（可选），非空则同步更新主表 description
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The extended JSON. This parameter is optional and uses the same format as the sandbox-synced extend field. If a non-empty value is specified, the extend field in the main table is also updated
parameters.help_zh: 扩展 JSON（可选，格式同沙箱同步的 extend），非空则同步更新主表 extend
parameters.name: extend
